name: Sitcom: Location Establishing Clip
description: Video preset for a location clip in the Sitcom look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second establishing shot. State the camera move, time of day, and two things moving in the scene. Keep the architecture consistent with the entity.
context_prompt: short establishing clip of the location with one slow camera move and ambient life in the frame, multi-camera sitcom still, bright even studio lighting, three-wall standing set dressed with lived-in detail, medium shot at eye level, high-key lighting with soft shadows, warm saturated colour, everything in focus, locked-off multi-camera coverage, cuts between medium shots, actors move within the set, no handheld
negative_prompt: dark moody lighting, cinematic shallow focus, horror, gritty grain, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
